    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Spring Boot4先行篇：第一篇 Spring Boot 创建 Docker 镜像</span>

<h2 id="前言">前言</h2>
<p><code>Spring Boot4</code>预计年底 11 月份发布，目前截止文章发布已经发布到了<code>4.0.0 RC2</code>版本；本文作为<code>Spring Boo4</code>专题学习预览篇，带你一起聊聊 <code>Spring Boot4</code>打包<code>Docker</code>镜像相关内容。</p>
<h2 id="前置准备">前置准备</h2>
<ol>
<li>需要搭建或者准备好 Spring Boot 项目，手动推荐搭建：<a href="https://start.spring.io/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://start.spring.io/</a></li>
</ol>
<p>笔者的 Spring Boot 项目 Github 链接：<a href="https://github.com/will-we/blog/tree/main/java/springboot4-samples" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/will-we/blog/tree/main/java/springboot4-samples</a></p>
<ol start="2">
<li>搭建<code>docker</code>环境</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="传统-docker-构建">传统 Docker 构建</h2>
<ol>
<li><code>Dockerfile</code>内容如下</li>
</ol>
<pre><code>ARG RUNTIME_IMAGE=amazoncorretto:17.0.7-alpine
FROM ${RUNTIME_IMAGE} AS runtime

# 拷贝打包后的可执行 JAR
COPY ./springboot4-samples-0.0.1.jar /app/app.jar
WORKDIR /app

# Spring Boot 默认端口
EXPOSE 8080

# 可通过环境变量调整运行参数/激活配置文件
ENV SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=default \
    JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS=""

# 直接运行可执行 JAR
ENTRYPOINT ["java","-jar","/app/app.jar"]
</code></pre>
<ol start="2">
<li>手动构建镜像：</li>
</ol>
<pre><code> docker build -t springboot4-samples:latest .
</code></pre>
<p>如下图：<img src="https://p0-xtjj-private.juejin.cn/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/970ec75f402c405193ac972e99b95579~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgd2lsbF93ZQ==:q75.awebp?policy=eyJ2bSI6MywidWlkIjoiMzMzMzM3NDk4NTYzODk0MSJ9&amp;rk3s=e9ecf3d6&amp;x-orig-authkey=f32326d3454f2ac7e96d3d06cdbb035152127018&amp;x-orig-expires=1762663705&amp;x-orig-sign=pxRL5bnXBqiDsIubZCk5UatD5V4%3D" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<ol start="3">
<li>启动镜像</li>
</ol>
<pre><code>docker run -p 8080:8080 springboot4-samples
</code></pre>
<p>日志如下：</p>
<p><img src="https://p0-xtjj-private.juejin.cn/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/120f0f9597c94675aad25dec5c96bbd8~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgd2lsbF93ZQ==:q75.awebp?policy=eyJ2bSI6MywidWlkIjoiMzMzMzM3NDk4NTYzODk0MSJ9&amp;rk3s=e9ecf3d6&amp;x-orig-authkey=f32326d3454f2ac7e96d3d06cdbb035152127018&amp;x-orig-expires=1762663706&amp;x-orig-sign=0ACCvxElx%2FlJOGzUdf6OEsxLiqM%3D" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="springboot插件构建"><code>SpringBoot</code>插件构建</h2>
<pre><code>mvn spring-boot:build-image
</code></pre>

<h2 id="构建对比分析">构建对比分析</h2>
<h3 id="springboot-插件构建">SpringBoot 插件构建</h3>
<p>实际上发生的事情：</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>打包应用（Jar/War）</strong></li>
</ol>
<ul>
<li>
<ul>
<li>先执行 <code>package</code> 阶段，生成一个可执行的 fat jar。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<ol start="2">
<li><strong>调用 Cloud Native Buildpacks（CNB）</strong></li>
</ol>
<ul>
<li>
<ul>
<li>Spring Boot Plugin 内部调用 <strong>Paketo Buildpacks</strong>（官方推荐）。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<ol start="3">
<li><strong>构建镜像（通过 lifecycle）</strong></li>
</ol>
<ul>
<li>
<ul>
<li>使用 CNB 的 <em>Lifecycle</em> 阶段：<code>detect → analyze → build → export</code>。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<ol start="4">
<li><strong>生成 OCI 镜像</strong></li>
</ol>
<ul>
<li>
<ul>
<li>输出一个可直接运行的 Docker 镜像（通常是 <code>docker.io/library/&lt;artifactId&gt;:&lt;version&gt;</code>）。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<ol start="5">
<li><strong>推送（可选）</strong></li>
</ol>
<ul>
<li>
<ul>
<li>若配置了 <code>publish=true</code>，则自动推送到远程镜像仓库。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://p0-xtjj-private.juejin.cn/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/7e93ae37b50a432698303cd8dd8aabfc~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgd2lsbF93ZQ==:q75.awebp?policy=eyJ2bSI6MywidWlkIjoiMzMzMzM3NDk4NTYzODk0MSJ9&amp;rk3s=e9ecf3d6&amp;x-orig-authkey=f32326d3454f2ac7e96d3d06cdbb035152127018&amp;x-orig-expires=1762663705&amp;x-orig-sign=g4USfWi9sHDBykBBsM%2F%2B79z6C2M%3D" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>阶段分析</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>阶段</th>
<th>作用</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>Detect</strong></td>
<td>检测是否有合适的 buildpack 来构建该项目（Spring Boot → Java buildpack）</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>Analyze</strong></td>
<td>分析缓存、上一次构建产物</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>Build</strong></td>
<td>运行 buildpacks 构建层（JDK层、依赖层、应用层）</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>Export</strong></td>
<td>导出成最终 OCI 镜像（可直接 docker run）</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>对比项</th>
<th>Buildpacks</th>
<th>Dockerfile</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>构建语言</td>
<td>声明式、自动检测</td>
<td>命令式、需人工编写</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>优化</td>
<td>自动层缓存、分层优化</td>
<td>手动优化层</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>安全性</td>
<td>由社区维护的基础镜像</td>
<td>需要自己维护</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>适合场景</td>
<td>Spring Boot / Cloud Native 架构</td>
<td>需要复杂构建逻辑的项目</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h2 id="docker-镜像推送">Docker 镜像推送</h2>
<h3 id="推送阿里云镜像仓库">推送阿里云镜像仓库</h3>
<pre><code>docker tag springboot4-samples:0.0.1 registry.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/weirson/springboot4-samples:0.0.1
docker push registry.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/weirson/springboot4-samples:0.0.1
</code></pre>
<h3 id="推送-docker-镜像仓库">推送 Docker 镜像仓库</h3>
<pre><code>docker tag springboot4-samples:0.0.1 weirson/springboot4-samples:0.0.1
docker push weirson/springboot4-samples:0.0.1
</code></pre>
